name: Greater Spark of Divinity (Heritage)
body:
Your divine blood reaches its peak of concentration and power.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Spark of Divinity, 13th level or higher.

Benefit(s): Choose death ward, divine power, or flame strike. You may use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day, at a caster level equal to your character level. At 15th level, and every 5 levels thereafter, you gain an additional use per day of the chosen spell.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time, you choose a different spell from the above list.
